name: POST /api/leadflow/contacts/export - only what the purpose permits
description:
Exports only the rows the stated purpose is actually permitted for, evaluated at export time.

THE PURPOSE IS REQUIRED, NEVER DEFAULTED. An export with no stated purpose cannot be eligibility-checked against anything, and a default would silently pick one on the operator's behalf — which is how a marketing extract gets taken from a list assembled for operations.

EXCLUDED ROWS ARE COUNTED AND EXPLAINED. An export that silently drops rows is a lie: the operator believes they hold the whole list and reconciles against it later. QA: measured live — the refusal, and an export reporting its exclusions grouped by reason.

testCases.name: The export reports what it took and what it excluded, with reasons
An export with no stated purpose is REFUSED
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: purpose is required - an export with no stated purpose cannot be checked against anybody's permitted uses, and defaulting one would pick it on the operator's behalf
Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
